info.title: Domovoi hub API
info.description: The hub's JSON API. Log in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`; the session is a cookie. Send the session's `csrf_token` as `X-CSRF-Token` on every unsafe request.

get.summary: Every rule, expired ones included. Rules that never expire come last.

200.description: Every rule, soonest expiry first; rules that never expire come last

post.summary: Creates a rule.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only this status name, for example `proposed`.

post.summary:
Approves a proposed action. Destructive skills need `confirm_text` equal to the skill's
name; chat buttons can never approve them.

409.description: Not proposed any more, or expired

post.summary: Denies a proposed action.

Logs in and sets the session cookie. Five failures a minute from one address lock it
out for a while.

200.description: Logged in; the cookie is set

post.summary: Ends the session and clears the cookie.

Creates the admin account with the one-time token from the setup link, and logs in.
Only works before the first user exists.

get.summary: Today's digest as it would be sent now.

post.summary: Sends today's digest now.

502.description: The chat platform did not take the digest

get.summary:
A stream of incident and action changes, as `incident` and `action` events whose data is
a JSON `UiEvent`.
Every host with its agent's presence, sorted by name.
Host `name` with its agent and the latest value of each digest fact from the last day.
A host's checks: what its agent reports and what the hub overrides.

put.summary: Replaces a host's check overrides and sends them to its agent; no restart.

post.summary:
A one-time enrollment invite for host `name`, creating the host if it is new. The
token is shown only in this response.
Revokes the agent of host `name` and disconnects it.

get.summary: Incidents, newest first, with optional filters.
Everything about one incident: report, card, timeline and actions.

post.summary: Acknowledges an incident.

Asks the triage model a follow-up question about an incident. It uses read-only tools
and never proposes actions.

503.description: Triage is off or the model is unavailable

post.summary:
Dismisses an incident as a known condition: closes it now with the verdict `EXPECTED`,
and when `ignore_for_minutes` is given, creates the rule that keeps the check quiet
(0 means always). The rule is stored before the incident closes, so a check firing in
the moment between the two is already silenced, and a dismiss that fails afterwards
leaves a rule that a human can see and delete on the Known conditions page. The rule
matches the incident's host, check and target; `note` is the reason, so a human can
read later what it covers. A target with `*` in it cannot be matched exactly by a rule
pattern, so dismissing such an incident with a period is refused.

400.description: Empty reason, too long, too many minutes, or a target a rule cannot match

post.summary: Mutes an incident for a while.

Runs triage again on an incident, outside the queue but with the same caps, and reports
how it went. A report already cached for unchanged evidence is reused unless `fresh` is
true.

parameters.name: fresh
parameters.description: Run the model again even when a cached report would fit. Default false.

post.summary: Lifts a mute.

get.summary: Notes about one host, or global notes when no host is given.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Only notes about this host, by name; absent for global notes.

post.summary: Creates a note.

Imports Markdown files as notes. Each note's title is its first `# ` heading or the
file name. Files that are not `.md`, too large, not UTF-8, empty, or titled like an
existing note in the same scope are skipped, so importing a folder twice adds nothing.

400.description: Too many files or an unreadable upload

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Also search this host's notes, by name.

get.summary: The current session and its CSRF token.

401.description: Not logged in; the error is `setup_required` while no account exists

patch.summary: Saves a change and restarts the hub with it.

400.description: Invalid; `issues` lists each problem with its path

403.description: Password missing or wrong for a sensitive change

409.description: Stale revision, or a field set in hub.toml or the environment

post.summary: Lists models available to the candidate primary provider.

get.summary: The JSON schema of `hub.toml`, for field help and defaults.

post.summary: Posts "Domovoi test message" with candidate Discord settings.
One GET of the candidate heartbeat URL.
One minimal call to the candidate primary model.

get.summary: Liveness: `ok` while the hub serves requests.

AckRuleDto.description: A known condition: incidents that match it stay in the history and never notify.

check.description: The check the rule matches, for example `security.ssh_login`.

expires_at.description: When the rule stops applying; null means it never expires.

host.description:
The host the rule is limited to, by name; null means every host. A host missing
from the store shows as `unknown host` with its id, so the list still works.

predicates.description: Conditions, all of which must hold.

target_pattern.description: Target pattern with `*` allowed at the ends; null means any target.

check.description: The check to match, for example `security.ssh_login`.

expires_in_minutes.description: Minutes from now until the rule stops applying; null means it never expires.

host.description: Host by name; null matches every host.

note.description: Why the condition is acceptable, 1 to 500 characters.

predicates.description: Conditions, all of which must hold; at most 10.

target_pattern.description: Target pattern with `*` allowed at the ends; null matches any target.

reason.description: Why it was rejected or failed.

status.description: The status name, for example `proposed` or `verified`.

ActionPage.description: One page of actions, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last.

host_id.description: The host it is about, if any.

confirm_text.description: For destructive skills: the skill's name typed exactly, as confirmation.

AskResponse.description: The answer to a follow-up question.

CardDto.description: The incident's chat card, as it would be posted.

badge.description:
A verdict (`ACTION_NEEDED`, `MONITOR`, `EXPECTED` or `FIXED`) or, before triage, a
severity (`info`, `warning` or `critical`).

details.description: Summary, cause and details, if triage ran.

next_step.description: The next step, if triage gave one.

CheckSettingsDto.description: One check's settings: on or off, interval, thresholds.

enabled.description: Whether the check runs; `None` keeps the agent's value.

interval_seconds.description: How often, in seconds; `None` keeps the agent's value.

DigestPreview.description: The daily digest as it would be sent now.

allowed_user_ids.description: Discord user ids allowed to press buttons.

DismissRequest.description: Dismissing an incident as a known condition.

ignore_for_minutes.description:
Minutes to keep the check quiet, 1 to 525600; 0 means always; null dismisses
without creating a rule, so the check alerts again.

reason.description: Why this is not a real problem, 1 to 500 characters.

EditableSettings.description: The settings as the UI edits them.

fields.description:
Where each field some layer set comes from: `ui`, `file` or `env:<VAR>`. A field
not listed uses its default. An entry for an array or a secret covers everything
under it. Fields from `file` or `env:` are locked in the UI.

issues.description: Problems with the current settings, each with its path.

last_apply.description: How the last apply went: `{ ok, at, message? }`.

revision.description: The revision a save must name.

values.description:
The merged values, shaped like `hub.toml`; every secret that has a value is
`"[set]"`, and a missing one is absent.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

error.description: A stable machine-readable code, for example `not_found`.

issues.description: For `invalid`: every problem, each with the settings path it is about.

EvidenceDto.description: One piece of evidence in a report.

FactDto.description: One digest fact about a host.

configured.description: Whether a heartbeat URL is configured.

failing.description: Whether the heartbeat-missing advisory is open.

interval.description: How often it is pinged, if configured.

oneOf.description: What the agent's own config sets, while it is connected.

checks.description: Every check the agent reported or the hub overrides, by key.

HostChecksSaved.description: Whether the agent got the change now.

delivered.description: True when sent to the connected agent; false when it gets them on reconnect.

HostChecksUpdate.description: New overrides for a host's checks, replacing the previous ones.

HostDetailDto.description: A host with its latest digest facts.

facts.description: The latest value of each fact seen in the last 24 hours, sorted by key.

HostDto.description: A host and its agent's presence.

agent_enrolled.description:
Whether the host has an enrolled, not revoked agent. The hub loses sight of agents
when it restarts, so this is what tells the UI an agent exists at all.

connected.description: Whether the agent is connected now.

last_seen.description: When it was last seen, while disconnected.

open_incidents.description: Incidents not yet resolved (pending, open, acked or muted), counted up to 200.

outdated.description: Whether the connected agent is older than the hub.

public_url.description: The URL people open, if set.

timezone.description: The time zone for quiet hours and the digest.

trusted_proxies.description: Proxies whose forwarded headers are trusted.

skipped_files.description: Each file left out, and why.

actions.description: Actions for this incident, newest first.

oneOf.description: The latest triage report, if any.

tools_used.description: Skills and tools used while triaging or answering, in first-call order.

oneOf.description: How the latest triage went, if it ran.

IncidentPage.description: One page of incidents, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last.

muted_until.description: When a mute ends, if muted.

target.description: What it was checked on, for example `/srv`.

InviteDto.description: An enrollment invite. Shown once; the token is not stored.

command.description: The command to run on the host.

fingerprint.description: The hub's certificate fingerprint the agent pins.

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it.

path.description: The dotted settings path, for example `llm.primary.model`; empty for the whole.

base_url.description: The API base URL, if set.

ModelsDto.description: Models available to a candidate provider.

minutes.description: How long, in minutes, 1 to 10080 (a week).

host_id.description: The host it is about, by id; absent for global notes.

body_markdown.description: Body in Markdown, at most 256 KiB.

host.description: The host it is about, by name; absent for a global note.

NotesImportForm.description: The form an import posts. Documents the request; the handler reads it field by field.

files.description: The Markdown files, one form field each. Only `.md` files are imported.

host.description: The host the notes are about, by name; absent for global notes.

kind.description: The type and its limits as JSON, for example `{"type":"integer","min":1,"max":10}`.

value.description: What the evidence must compare with, as text.

PredicateOpDto.description: How a condition compares an evidence value with its `value`.

headline.description: What is wrong, in one line.

revoked.description: `false` when the host had no live agent.

applied.description: Whether the hub restarted with the change.

oneOf.description:
Everything the settings page edits; `None` when the hub runs from a fixed
configuration and settings are read-only.
The primary model provider, if configured.
The fallback model provider, if configured.

base_revision.description: The revision the change was made on; a stale one answers 409.

changes.description:
The changes, shaped like `hub.toml`. `null` removes a value so the lower layers
apply. A secret takes `{ "keep": true }`, `{ "set": "…" }` or `{ "clear": true }`.

password.description:
The admin's password, needed when the change touches chat approvers, trusted
proxies, webhooks or any secret.

SetupRequest.description: Creating the admin account on first run.

token.description: The token from the setup link the hub logged.

username.description: Login name, 1 to 64 characters without spaces.

timeout_secs.description: How long one run may take, in seconds.

SkippedFileDto.description: A file a notes import left out.

TestRequest.description: Candidate values for a connection test; nothing is saved.

changes.description: The same shape as a save; a secret left as `{ "keep": true }` uses the stored one.

TestResultDto.description: The result of a connection test.

latency_ms.description: How long it took, in milliseconds.

ToolUsageDto.description: One skill or tool used while triaging or answering a follow-up.

calls.description: How many times it was called.

failures.description: How many of those calls failed.

name.description: The tool name, or the skill name for a read skill.

monthly_budget_usd.description: Monthly spending cap in US dollars, if set.

TriageStateDto.description: How triage went for an incident.

reason.description: Why it was skipped or failed.

UiEvent.description: A change the web UI should show, sent on the event stream.

action_id.description: The action concerned, for action events.

status.description: The new status name, when it changed.

cost_usd.description: Cost in US dollars, as far as prices are configured.

default_host.description: The host used when the payload names none.
